title: Spreading a list with apply
description: You can compare separate numeric arguments with a single list argument.

steps.description: The quote supplies the list (1 2 3) as data. You pass that list and the procedure + to apply.
apply spreads the three elements into separate arguments. The resulting addition is (+ 1 2 3).

steps.question: Does the direct + call receive three numbers?
steps.answer: No. It receives one list argument, which the tutorial identifies as an error for +.

steps.description: You see 6 from the apply call in the supplied output. The second line illustrates the invalid direct call; this recording includes no error text to quote.
